record.field: A tag on the washer, the garage door, the intercom. The occupant taps it, describes the problem in one sentence, and a filled-in ticket (the place, the time, the building record) reaches the support team. Occupants have no account: engrave these tags on signed chips.
Washer 1 ; basement laundry room Garage door ; parking Intercom ; lobby
Printer or photocopier out of order
A tag on each device. Paper jam, toner, error screen: one sentence, and the ticket goes out with the device and the place already filled in.
